upload.title: Document Parser
upload.description: Upload a document (PDF, Office file or image) — a vision model will extract its full, structured content as Markdown.

errors.submitFailed: Could not send the document for processing

outcome.queued: The job is waiting in the queue…
outcome.processing: Processing the document — conversion, page rendering and extraction by the vision model…
outcome.truncated_one: The document has more pages than the processing limit — the result covers only the first page.
outcome.truncated_few: The document has more pages than the processing limit — the result covers only the first {{count}} pages.
outcome.truncated_many: The document has more pages than the processing limit — the result covers only the first {{count}} pages.
outcome.truncated_other: The document has more pages than the processing limit — the result covers only the first {{count}} pages.

history.title: History
history.description: Document extraction jobs you uploaded — status, metadata and result.

empty.title: No jobs
empty.description: Upload your first document on the upload screen — it will appear here once processing finishes.

detail.title: Job details
detail.description: The full extraction result, metadata and (for failed jobs) the complete message.
detail.promptHint: One built-in prompt for every job in this version of the module — useful when judging the quality of the result above.

notFound.title: Job not found
notFound.description: The job does not exist or you do not have access to it.

unsupported-format.title: Unsupported file format
unsupported-format.hint: This file type is not supported. Check the list of allowed extensions and try again.

file-too-large.title: File is too large
file-too-large.hint: Reduce the document size or split it into smaller parts and try again.

conversion-failed.title: Could not process the document
conversion-failed.hint: The file may be corrupted, or the conversion service is temporarily unavailable. Try uploading the document again.

vision-call-failed.title: Vision model error
vision-call-failed.hint: The AI model failed to extract the document content. Try again in a moment.

page-limit-exceeded.title: Page limit exceeded
page-limit-exceeded.hint: The document has more pages than the allowed limit. Shorten it and try again.

unknown.title: Processing failed
unknown.hint: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

validation.missingExtension: The file has no extension — its format cannot be determined.
